prompts.base: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a wide 1536x1024 illustrated fantasy parchment world map, physical aged cream paper laid flat, luminous warm hand-painted watercolor and delicate brown ink, classic Elder Scrolls Oblivion paper cartography. Entire rectangular image is parchment, fine ornamental border. Geography only. A broad EMPTY grassy clearing exactly at center (50%,50%); winding trails radiate north east south west. North at (50%,22%) rocky alpine mountains; east (79%,50%) golden green woodland; south (50%,79%) pale sage marsh and winding streams; west (21%,50%) weathered rocky moor with a few distant anonymous ancient broken stones. Small compass rose bottom right. Keep region centers open for separate interactive objects. No buildings, towers, foundations, campfires, tents, huts, mines, creatures, people, nodes, crystals, dungeons or resource objects anywhere. No text labels (accessible labels supplied by game). Bright readable honey cream parchment, restrained green washes, inviting sophisticated illustrated tabletop map. No UI, no cards, no grid, no dark panels.

prompts.landmarks: Use case: stylized-concept. Game asset: TRANSPARENT PNG sprite atlas of 16 separate fantasy parchment map landmark miniatures. Exactly 4 equal columns and 4 equal rows in a square canvas, each miniature strictly centered in its own equal square cell, with wide transparent padding within every cell so no sprite touches another. No visible grid or labels. Warm light watercolor and fine sepia ink, tiny isometric overhead map landmarks, consistent small scale, bright cream stone and sage foliage. Row 1 left to right: patch of pale wild plants; a winding dirt footpath with small grass tufts; a rocky cave mouth; an abandoned modest canvas camp shelter. Row 2: small pile of rocky scree; timber-braced mine entrance in a small rock outcrop; rustic hunter log cabin exterior ONLY no tools; quiet little grove of three trees NO animals. Row 3: a tiny herb patch; a crooked thatched cottage exterior ONLY; overgrown field rows; a small broken roadside stone arch. Row 4: a squat ruined gearworks building exterior ONLY no machinery; a pale windowless sealed archive exterior ONLY no interior or crystals; a small constructed fantasy brass mana condenser; a small stone earth elemental. Every sprite isolated on true transparent alpha background. No text, no numbers, no icons, no UI, no shadows filling cells, no terrain beyond each compact miniature.
